limits: Judgments concern authored synthetic packets; no actual-world performance was measured. Novelty is local to the incomplete frozen archive.
All 12 packet hashes matched. Every one of 46 raw openings received an assessment and an independent retention check; no family was introduced only by Distill.

Preserves rates the bounded measurement/probe and its release gates, not demonstrated durability, delivery, area yield or batch success. Conditional is reserved for explicitly relaxed premises; none were required here.

Uncertain fit identifies additional material, fixture, stock allowance or access prerequisites. Distill keeps these uncertainties and gates adoption, so none is represented as an established usable solution.
Related component combinations are grouped despite differing rigor: outperforming either component does not establish superadditivity. Counterfactual causal predictions remain speculative.

Equivalent corner remedies are separated only where operations differ: contour change, elastic yielding, or retained preset reserve. Specific constructions and extra checks alone earn no new mechanism novelty.
No method label was sought or confidently identified. No idea was parked or dropped; retention does not recommend adoption.
